pages.text: Well done - you've got the centrepiece of this mod. Hold [$(k:use)] and you'll see particles gathering at your feet in an ever-widening circle, showing the area that is about to travel with you.
Hold [$(k:use)] for the full duration and you, along with everything else inside the circle, are carried into your soul. This is how you'd bring friends and livestock along.
All you need is a little bit of iron and an ender pearl
pages.title: SoulKey
